WITH latest AS (
  SELECT 
    patient_id, 
    value, 
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY patient_id ORDER BY test_date DESC, lab_id DESC) AS rn 
  FROM lab_results 
  WHERE test_name = 'HbA1c' 
    AND year(test_date) = 2025
), 
diabetics AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT patient_id 
  FROM diagnoses 
  WHERE icd10_code LIKE 'E11%'
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN l.value < 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS controlled_pct
FROM latest l
JOIN diabetics d ON d.patient_id = l.patient_id
WHERE l.rn = 1

SELECT 
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lr.value < 7 THEN p.patient_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT p.patient_id), 1) AS controlled_diabetes_pct

  patients p
JOIN 
  visits v ON p.patient_id = v.patient_id

  lab_results lr ON lr.visit_id = v.visit_id

  calendar cal ON cal.date = lr.test_date

  p.nationality_group = 'Qatari'
  AND lr.test_name = 'HbA1c'
  AND cal.year = 2025
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM diagnoses d
    WHERE d.patient_id = p.patient_id
    AND d.icd10_code LIKE 'E11%'
  )

    FROM lab_results

    FROM diagnoses
    WHERE icd10_code LIKE 'E11%'
),

  c.clinic_name,
  ROUND(100.0 * no_show_ramadan / total_appointments_ramadan, 1) AS no_show_rate_ramadan_pct,
  ROUND(100.0 * no_show_feb / total_appointments_feb, 1) AS no_show_rate_feb_pct,
  ROUND(100.0 * (no_show_ramadan / total_appointments_ramadan - no_show_feb / total_appointments_feb), 1) AS no_show_rate_increase_pct
FROM (
  SELECT 
    a.clinic_id,
    COUNT(*) AS total_appointments_ramadan,
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 'no_show' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_show_ramadan
  FROM appointments a
  JOIN calendar cal ON cal.date = a.appointment_date
  WHERE cal.is_ramadan AND cal.year = 2025
  GROUP BY a.clinic_id
) r
JOIN (
  SELECT 
    a.clinic_id,
    COUNT(*) AS total_appointments_feb,
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 'no_show' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_show_feb
  FROM appointments a
  JOIN calendar cal ON cal.date = a.appointment_date
  WHERE cal.month = 2 AND cal.year = 2025
  GROUP BY a.clinic_id
) f
ON r.clinic_id = f.clinic_id
JOIN clinics c ON c.clinic_id = r.clinic_id
ORDER BY no_show_rate_increase_pct DESC

SELECT 
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN completed_date <= due_date + INTERVAL '14 days' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS on_time_completion_pct
FROM 
  follow_ups
WHERE 
  year(due_date) = 2025

SELECT 
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.completed_date <= f.due_date + INTERVAL '14 days' THEN f.follow_up_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.follow_up_id), 1) AS on_time_completion_rate_pct
FROM 
  follow_ups f
WHERE 
  year(f.due_date) = 2025

SELECT p.nationality_group, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT v.patient_id), 2) AS visits_per_patient 
FROM visits v 
JOIN patients p ON p.patient_id = v.patient_id 
WHERE year(v.visit_date) = 2025 
GROUP BY p.nationality_group 
ORDER BY p.nationality_group

SELECT 
  p.nationality_group, 
  ROUND(AVG(visit_count), 1) AS avg_visits_per_patient
FROM 
  patients p
JOIN (
  SELECT 
    patient_id, 
    COUNT(*) AS visit_count
  FROM 
    visits
  WHERE 
    YEAR(visit_date) = 2025
  GROUP BY 
    patient_id
  HAVING 
    COUNT(*) >= 1
) AS patient_visits ON p.patient_id = patient_visits.patient_id
GROUP BY 
  p.nationality_group
ORDER BY 
  avg_visits_per_patient DESC

SELECT 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM appointment_date) AS month,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'no_show' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('attended', 'no_show') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS no_show_rate_pct
FROM appointments
WHERE year(appointment_date) = 2025
GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM appointment_date)
ORDER BY no_show_rate_pct DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
  cal.month_name AS month_name,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 'no_show' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN a.status IN ('attended', 'no_show') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS no_show_rate_pct
FROM 
  appointments a
JOIN 
  clinics c ON c.clinic_id = a.clinic_id
JOIN 
  calendar cal ON cal.date = a.appointment_date
WHERE 
  cal.year = 2025
GROUP BY 
  cal.month_name
ORDER BY 
  no_show_rate_pct DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT v.patient_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT p.patient_id), 1) AS pct_with_visit
FROM 
  patients p
LEFT JOIN 
  visits v ON p.patient_id = v.patient_id
WHERE 
  p.age_band = '60+' 
  AND v.visit_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY 
  p.age_band

SELECT 
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN v.visit_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' THEN p.patient_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.age_band = '60+' THEN p.patient_id END), 1) AS visited_once_rate_pct
FROM patients p
LEFT JOIN visits v ON p.patient_id = v.patient_id
WHERE p.age_band = '60+'
  AND v.visit_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'

WITH clinic_visits AS (
  SELECT 
    clinic_id, 
    SUM(CASE WHEN year(visit_date) = 2024 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS visits_2024, 
    SUM(CASE WHEN year(visit_date) = 2025 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS visits_2025
  FROM visits
  GROUP BY clinic_id
)
SELECT 
  c.clinic_name, 
  visits_2024, 
  visits_2025, 
  ROUND(100.0 * (visits_2025 - visits_2024) / visits_2024, 1) AS change_pct
FROM clinic_visits
JOIN clinics c ON c.clinic_id = clinic_visits.clinic_id
ORDER BY change_pct DESC

SELECT 
  COUNT_2024.clinic_name,
  ROUND(100.0 * (COUNT_2025.count_2025 - COUNT_2024.count_2024) / COUNT_2024.count_2024, 1) AS change_percentage
FROM
  (SELECT 
    c.clinic_name,
    COUNT(*) AS count_2024
   FROM visits v
   JOIN calendar cal ON cal.date = v.visit_date
   JOIN clinics c ON c.clinic_id = v.clinic_id
   WHERE cal.year = 2024
   GROUP BY c.clinic_name) AS COUNT_2024
JOIN
  (SELECT 
    c.clinic_name,
    COUNT(*) AS count_2025
   FROM visits v
   JOIN calendar cal ON cal.date = v.visit_date
   JOIN clinics c ON c.clinic_id = v.clinic_id
   WHERE cal.year = 2025
   GROUP BY c.clinic_name) AS COUNT_2025
ON COUNT_2024.clinic_name = COUNT_2025.clinic_name
ORDER BY change_percentage DESC

SELECT 
  ROUND(100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN p2.drug_class = 'Vitamin D supplements' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS prescribed_pct
FROM 
  lab_results l
JOIN 
  patients p ON p.patient_id = l.patient_id
JOIN 
  prescriptions p2 ON p2.patient_id = p.patient_id
WHERE 
  l.test_name = 'Vitamin D'
  AND l.value < 20
  AND year(l.test_date) = 2025
  AND year(p2.prescribed_date) = 2025

SELECT 
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pr.prescription_id IS NOT NULL THEN pr.patient_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lr.test_name = 'Vitamin D' THEN lr.patient_id END), 1) AS vitamin_d_supplement_rate_pct
FROM 
  lab_results lr
JOIN 
  patients p ON p.patient_id = lr.patient_id
LEFT JOIN 
  prescriptions pr ON pr.patient_id = lr.patient_id 
  AND pr.prescribed_date >= CAST(DATE_SUB(CAST(lr.test_date AS DATE), INTERVAL 1 YEAR) AS DATE)
  AND pr.prescribed_date <= CAST(lr.test_date AS DATE)
WHERE 
  lr.test_name = 'Vitamin D'
  AND lr.value < 20
  AND YEAR(lr.test_date) = 2025

  AND (year(s.screening_date) = 2024 OR year(s.screening_date) = 2025)

  p.sex = 'Female' 
  AND p.age_band IN ('50-59', '60+')

FROM 
  screenings s
JOIN 
  patients p ON p.patient_id = s.patient_id
JOIN 
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) AS female_50_plus
   FROM patients
   WHERE sex = 'Female'
     AND age_band IN ('50-59', '60+')) total
ON TRUE

  s.screening_type = 'Breast cancer'
  AND year(s.screening_date) IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY 
  total.female_50_plus
